title: Exact minimum base size for symmetric actions on r-subsets and the corresponding alternating action when n is at least two r
author: del Valle, Coen; Roney-Dougal, Colva M.
work: The base size of the symmetric group acting on subsets
difficulty_reason: Deferring the quoted Halasi reduction and the Behrens et al. degree-sequence theorem, the counted argument is source-local but elementary: bases for the subset action are translated by duality into irrepeating hypergraphs, and the exact threshold is obtained from a two-way double count together with a nearly-regular uniform hypergraph construction on the layers where 0<=m_r(l,k)<=binom(l,k). The symmetric case then closes by comparing the minimal admissible l with the true base size b, and the alternating case by the neighbourhood-equality criterion at the extra point n+1. The ingredients are graduate-level combinatorics rather than deep machinery, so within the above-qualifying band this is graded H2, with the exact hypothesis n>=2r and the minimality of l retained unchanged.
